name: dua-web-app
description: Dua reader: Next.js client + Express/SQLite API.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.format: prettier --write client/app client/components client/lib server/src server/test
